effects.clear: The gate stays at frame #1D with MarkSolidHere and MarkSolidOffset(#00, #03) active.

meanings.notes: The wait is a consumed one-shot trigger (WaitOnFlagByte then ClearFlagByte of the same index), so the gate closes again after the #77 ticks and every later hit re-opens it. Producer: hit_switch type byte 03 (scene_actors ;2C of scene 133).

effects.set: sp58_missed_flight and sp58_descent_cutscene leave their wait loops (missed_flight then sets scratch $02); sp58_red_eye leaves its loop for code_0681F0 (Neil flies off, ClearAllWramFlags, QueueMapChange to scene $59).

ClearAllWramFlags at sp58_red_eye.asm:68 zeroes the scratch flags and the word flags before the scene change.

meanings.summary: Scratch bits $08-$0F are read as the single byte $0A01: a hit counter. Each of the four dm3F_switch placements zeroes it at spawn and adds 1 per hit; dm3F_mine_collapse_trigger fires when the byte equals 4.
meanings.notes: The counter does not track freed laborers: hits on any of the four switches (scene_actors ;1D-;20 of scene 63) increase it, and each spawn of a switch resets it, so a later-spawned switch placement would restart the count. hit_switch with a type byte of 10 or more would also write these bits; no such placement exists in scene 63. The flag word $0121 latches the collapse.

effects.clear: The six statue archers stay solid props: each restores its own position and HP every frame.
